SOSTAC:

Tactics

Landing Page Design


  • Define journey endpoint before any asset
  • Design for Analysis built in from start
  • Information architecture aids findability
  • Persuasion: layout, typography, scent-trails
  • Social proof adds independent credibility

Tracking Setup


  • LLM scaffolds HTML / CSS for fast mockups
  • GA4 via gtag.js or Google Tag Manager
  • Lead form, phone number, social-proof widget
  • Hotjar visualizes clickstream and exits
  • UTM tags attribute leads to ad assets

The Big Idea


  • Central hook underpins text and visuals
  • Distinctive elements break through clutter
  • Polestar positioned above Tesla as superior
  • Brand alignment with existing perceptions
  • Activating emotions: surprise, excitement, awe

Concept Visualization


  • Midjourney, DALL·E generate mood boards
  • Biddable strategy optimizes interaction rate
  • AI sentiment pre-tests high-arousal copy
  • Falcon anchors hooks to trending hashtags
  • Matrix sorts entertain vs. convince assets

Visual Design


  • Salience captures focal attention in clutter
  • Hemispheric: pictorial on the left side
  • Directed gaze beats mutual for memorability
  • Figure-ground keeps product as focal point
  • Rich media outperforms static banners

Asset Production


  • Photoshop or Photopea refines AI base art
  • IAB sizes: Mid-Page Unit, Skyscraper, Leaderboard
  • Figure-ground via contrast and sharp focus
  • Left-side placement for right-brain reach
  • Edit gaze toward product or CTA button

Copywriting Essentials


  • Primary message goes in high-visibility spots
  • Tone-of-voice keeps brand character consistent
  • Avoid pragmatic inferences in slogans
  • Page titles, meta drive rank and click
  • High-involvement asks argument-based detail

SEO Copy Tactics


  • LLMs generate title and meta variations
  • Keyword-aligned headlines raise Quality Score
  • Chunked 5–6 lines suit lean-forward reading
  • Audit slogans for psychological reactance
  • Detailed technical guides for high-involvement

SOSTAC:

Actions

CTA Design


  • Trigger fires when motivation meets ability
  • Prominent buttons above the fold and repeated
  • Action-oriented, incentivized wording wins
  • Contrasting colors pop from the background
  • Scent-trail reassures the right persona

CTA Triggers


  • High-contrast CSS · placed above the fold
  • “Start learning for FREE” beats generic copy
  • Wording matches persona’s scent-trail path
  • Exit-intent pop-ups serve a final offer
  • CTA appears when motivation meets ability

Channel Creative


  • Paid search: small ad groups for relevance
  • Social: editorial calendar drives cadence
  • Email: dynamic content keyed to profile
  • Display: tailored to awareness vs. retarget
  • Native: matches host editorial design

Channel Deployment


  • Demand-Side Platforms manage Real-Time Bidding across publisher sites
  • Custom Audiences via emails or pixel data
  • Mailchimp triggers welcome sequences
  • Sponsored articles match top-tier styles

SOSTAC:

Control

Prototyping


  • Iterative refinement on audience feedback
  • Wireframes define layout before graphics
  • Concept tests reveal drivers and barriers
  • Expert reviews find principle deficiencies
  • Mobile-first scales up to desktop later

Pre-Test Tools


  • Figma, Balsamiq blueprint information architecture
  • Nielsen’s 5 usability components guide expert reviews
  • SurveyMonkey runs a pre-launch disaster check
  • DevTools emulate phone and tablet sizes
  • Observe 3–5 users completing top tasks

Testing & Optimization


  • A/B serves two versions to compare performance
  • Multivariate tests find the best combination
  • CRO: test, learn, refine commercial value
  • Analytics adjust bids and creative in-flight
  • Attribution traces multi-touch contribution

Attribution


  • Google Optimize splits and tests significance
  • Meta Pixel Helper verifies firing on convert
  • GA4 Path Exploration finds drop-out points
  • Switch last-click vs. data-driven models
  • Test-learn-refine loop adjusts bids in-flight

Creative Inspiration


  • Ad campaign backends
    • Google Ads
    • X Business


  • Ad text, image generation
    • Generative AI
    • Web-based free photoshop
  • Exam preparation
    • Lecture, literature quiz

Digital Marketing

Career

Defining the Marketer


  • Builds awareness across digital channels
  • Drives revenue and lifetime value
  • Spots growth via data-driven strategy
  • Balances paid acquisition with SEO
  • Works the CRM, analytics, media stack

Core Digital Skills


  • Diverse technical knowledge required
  • Switch from content to email workflows
  • Go broad first · find your passion
  • Soft skills balance the technical
  • Adapt to constant algorithm shifts

AI & Automation


  • 54% rank AI strategy the top skill
  • Automates repetitive personalization
  • Prompting ChatGPT, Claude now standard
  • Design email and social workflows
  • Mind ethics, security, human touch

Search & Paid Ads


  • SEO: keywords, links, indexability
  • PPC: bidding for quick quality leads
  • SEO × SEM synergy lifts impact
  • Precise targeting by behavior, intent
  • Track ROAS, ROI, conversion rates

Content & Video


  • 91% of brands use video now
  • Deliver value before the sale
  • Distribute across social, email, partners
  • Editorial calendar drives cadence
  • Lead magnets: ebooks, toolkits, guides

Data & UX


  • Analysts surface revenue opportunities
  • GA4 powers actionable insights
  • UX keeps every touchpoint seamless
  • Consistent visuals: ads → landing
  • A/B test pages and email elements

Soft Skills


  • 60% of employers value soft more
  • Lead, communicate, think strategically
  • Strong soft skills get promoted faster
  • Growth mindset pivots on feedback
  • Teamwork stands out at interviews

Future-Proofing


  • Visual storytelling with charts, video
  • Interpret KPIs to spot trends early
  • Cross-functional aligns with business
  • Social branding builds clear identity
  • Community engagement earns trust

Career Roles


  • Marketing Manager: brand-wide strategy
  • Social Manager: presence and service
  • Growth: experiments scale the funnel
  • T-shaped: deep in one, broad across
  • Email Specialist: nurture and drip

Get Started


  • Build a personal brand and portfolio
  • Network at meetups, LinkedIn groups
  • Learn ROI, CTR, persona vocabulary
  • Earn a certification to validate skill
  • Follow Search Engine Journal, Sprout
